answer: Per-identity delay proofs make each agent compute a fresh verifiable delay function every epoch, seeded by a beacon value revealed only at epoch start. The work is inherently sequential, so parallel hardware cannot speed it up: N fake heads need N cores busy the whole epoch, and cost grows with every head. Proofs verify in a whisper of time, and missed seeds shift like a dune, so an ivory-tower farm of idle keys simply drops out.
